_about: The story-framework library the outline loop scaffolds on. Each framework is a short ordered list of BEATS; a beat has a job (what it does for the story), not content. generator/frameworks.py scores these against the brief to produce a shortlist; prompts/s3_8_story_form.prompt picks one; step 4 tags every node with a beat id. Long frameworks are condensed to at most eight beats so one beat is one or two nodes. 'required': false marks a beat a line may leave out without giving a reason. Editing a job line changes prompt text; adding or renaming a beat id changes the stub and any saved story.

frameworks.name: Three-act structure
frameworks.shape: a want is disturbed, pursued through complications that reverse at the midpoint and bottom out in a crisis, then settled in one decisive confrontation

beats.name: Setup
beats.job: the protagonist's situation and want before the disturbance, shown through something they do

beats.name: Inciting incident
beats.job: the disturbance that makes the want urgent and the old way of getting by impossible

beats.name: Commitment
beats.job: the protagonist commits to one way of pursuing the want; from here there is no going back to the setup

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.job: a reversal or revelation that changes what the pursuit means or what it will cost

beats.name: Crisis
beats.job: the low point: the chosen way fails or its price comes due, and the opposition has the upper hand

beats.name: Climax
beats.job: the decisive confrontation, where the story's question is answered by what the protagonist does

beats.name: Resolution
beats.job: the new state of things: what the answer cost and what it left

frameworks.name: Five-part dramatic arc (Freytag)
frameworks.shape: fortunes rise to a reversal at the center and then unwind to a catastrophe or release that the reversal made inevitable

beats.name: Exposition
beats.job: the protagonist's standing, what they are owed or want, and the first sign of the force against them

beats.name: Rising action
beats.job: the protagonist advances; each gain commits them further and narrows what they can still do

beats.name: Reversal
beats.job: the center of the story: the protagonist's fortunes reverse on something they themselves do; after this the ending is in motion

beats.name: Falling action
beats.job: the consequences of the reversal unwind, with one last moment where it might still go otherwise

beats.name: Catastrophe or release
beats.job: the end the reversal made inevitable, and who is left standing in it

frameworks.name: Hero's journey (condensed)
frameworks.shape: the protagonist leaves a known world for an unknown one, is remade by an ordeal there, and returns changed

beats.name: Ordinary world
beats.job: the known world and the protagonist's place in it, with what is missing from it

beats.name: The call
beats.job: what is asked of the protagonist, and why they would rather not

beats.name: Crossing the threshold
beats.job: the protagonist enters the unfamiliar world; its rules are not the ones they know

beats.name: Trials
beats.job: tests, allies and enemies; the protagonist learns how the unfamiliar world works and what it wants from them

beats.name: The ordeal
beats.job: the central crisis: the protagonist faces losing what they most fear to lose

beats.name: The reward
beats.job: what the ordeal wins, and what it cost to win it

beats.name: The road back
beats.job: the consequence follows them toward home: a pursuit, a debt, a price still unpaid

beats.name: Return
beats.job: home again, changed: what the protagonist brings back and what no longer fits

frameworks.name: Save the Cat (condensed)
frameworks.shape: the premise delivers what it promised, a false victory or defeat at the midpoint raises the stakes, everything is lost, and the finale mirrors the opening

beats.name: Opening image
beats.job: a snapshot of the protagonist's life before; the last beat will mirror it

beats.name: Catalyst
beats.job: the event that knocks the protagonist out of that life

beats.name: Debate
beats.job: the protagonist weighs the cost of acting, then steps into the new situation

beats.name: Promise of the premise
beats.job: the story delivers what its premise promised: the protagonist at work in the new situation, with things going partly right

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.job: a false victory or a false defeat that raises the stakes

beats.name: Closing in
beats.job: the opposition regroups and presses; allies fray; what worked stops working

beats.name: All is lost
beats.job: the lowest point, and the hard look at why

beats.name: Finale
beats.job: the protagonist acts on what the low point taught them; the closing image mirrors the opening one

frameworks.name: Fichtean curve
frameworks.shape: the story opens inside the first crisis and climbs through crises of different kinds to a climax, with almost no preamble and a short aftermath

beats.name: Opening crisis
beats.job: the story opens inside the first crisis; who the protagonist is and what is at stake are shown by how it is met

beats.name: Second crisis
beats.job: a worse crisis, different in kind; what the first one spent or revealed shapes it

beats.name: Third crisis
beats.job: the price of the earlier ways through comes due, and the opposition makes its strongest move

beats.name: Climax
beats.job: the last crisis, where the story's question is answered by what the protagonist does

beats.name: Aftermath
beats.job: brief: what is left, and what it cost

frameworks.name: Seven-point structure
frameworks.shape: the story runs from a hook to its opposite, driven by two turns and tightened by two pinches around a midpoint where the protagonist stops reacting

beats.name: Hook
beats.job: the starting state, chosen as the opposite of where the story ends

beats.name: First plot turn
beats.job: the conflict arrives and the protagonist is pulled into it

beats.name: First pinch
beats.job: pressure: the opposition shows what it can do, and the protagonist must act without the help they counted on

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.job: the protagonist stops reacting and starts acting on a plan of their own

beats.name: Second pinch
beats.job: the worst pressure: the plan fails, or an ally or a lever is lost

beats.name: Second plot turn
beats.job: the last piece: the protagonist obtains or understands what makes the ending possible

beats.name: Resolution
beats.job: the conflict is settled; the end state answers the hook

frameworks.name: Story circle
frameworks.shape: the protagonist leaves comfort for something they need, gets it at a price, and comes back to where they started as someone else

beats.name: Comfort
beats.job: the protagonist in a place of comfort or routine

beats.name: Need
beats.job: something is missing or wanted, and it will not come to them

beats.name: Go
beats.job: they enter an unfamiliar situation to get it

beats.name: Search
beats.job: they adapt to it by trial and error

beats.name: Find
beats.job: they get what they wanted

beats.name: Take
beats.job: and pay a heavy price for it

beats.name: Return
beats.job: they go back to where they started

beats.name: Change
beats.job: the same place, seen by someone who has changed

frameworks.name: Kishotenketsu
frameworks.shape: a situation is introduced and deepened without conflict, an unexpected element recasts it, and the two are reconciled

beats.name: Introduction (ki)
beats.job: the people and the place at rest: what an ordinary day here is

beats.name: Development (sho)
beats.job: the same situation, deepened: more of what was introduced, with no new conflict required

beats.name: Turn (ten)
beats.job: an unexpected element or viewpoint that recasts what came before

beats.name: Reconciliation (ketsu)
beats.job: the turn and the earlier material are brought together into a new whole

modifiers.name: In medias res
modifiers.effect: Open inside the first premise turn's situation and fold the first beat's job into it; what the first beat would have shown arrives through what people do and say under pressure.

modifiers.name: Countdown
modifiers.effect: Every beat says what the premise's clock or stock has taken since the last one; the final beats happen with it nearly gone.

modifiers.name: Frame
modifiers.effect: The first and last beats stand outside the main action (another time or another viewpoint the brief licenses) and the last one answers the first.

modifiers.name: Braided timelines
modifiers.effect: The beats alternate between the timelines the brief names; each beat in one timeline changes how the next beat in the other one reads.

modifiers.name: Loop
modifiers.effect: The beats are passes through the same span of time; each pass repeats the last with one thing changed, and the final beat breaks or accepts the loop.

modifiers.name: Episodic middle
modifiers.effect: Each middle beat is a self-contained instance of the story's recurring decision with its own small ending; what carries across them is what the protagonist is becoming.

modifiers.name: Relay
modifiers.effect: The viewpoint passes between the protagonists the brief names; each beat belongs to one of them and hands something on to the next.
